title: Generate to Explore, Select to Exploit: Aligning LLM-based Headline Generation with Personalized Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2609.15094v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In industrial recommendation feeds, presenting a static headline for an item often fails to satisfy the diverse, multimodal interests of the user population, particularly suppressing the needs of long-tail audiences. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have been integrated into recommendation for content understanding or ranking, directly optimizing them to output a single best headline typically leads to mode collapse---converging to generic patterns that satisfy average tastes but miss specific latent intents. translated_title: 生成以探索，选择以利用：将基于大语言模型的标题生成与个性化推荐相对齐
translated_abstract: 在工业推荐信息流中，为一个条目展示静态标题往往无法满足用户群体多样化、多模态的兴趣，尤其会抑制长尾受众的需求。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）已被集成到推荐系统中用于内容理解或排序，但直接优化它们以输出单一最佳标题通常会导致模式坍塌——即收敛到满足平均口味的通用模式，却错失了特定的潜在意图。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了GESE（生成以探索，选择以利用），这是一个在系统展示层运行的框架，将个性化解耦为生成式探索和选择性利用两个阶段。首先，我们将LLM视为概率探索者，利用带有分层奖励机制的组序列策略优化（GSPO）生成候选集合，以最大化语义覆盖范围。
tldr: 提出GESE框架，将LLM作为概率探索者生成多样化标题候选集，再进行选择性利用，解决了工业推荐系统中单一静态标题导致模式坍塌、无法满足用户多样化兴趣的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces GESE, a presentation-layer framework that decouples personalization into generative exploration and selective exploitation, using LLMs as probabilistic explorers with GSPO and hierarchical rewards to generate diverse headline candidates and overcome mode collapse in industrial recommendation feeds.
